Marta (People Ops): welcome Noah! Quick security checklist for your first week: enroll in MDM, enable disk encryption, set up 2FA (hardware key or authenticator app), and finish the "Security Quickstart" course. Ping IT Support if you hit enrollment errors.

Noah Chen: thanks! Quick Q — i have a personal laptop i want to use. Will Redwood see my files if i enroll?

Liam - InfoSec: Short answer: no. For BYOD we only apply a minimal work profile and policies required for access (VPN cert, encryption check, passcode rules). We don't read personal files or install corporate apps on your personal home directory. Full remote wipe only applies to company-owned devices.

Noah Chen: cool. Also, the training dashboard shows "pending" after i clicked the link. Is that normal?

security-bot: Training status -> Noah Chen: "Security Quickstart" (id: 710) assigned. Status: Pending. Due: 2026-04-08.

Marta (People Ops): pending is fine while SSO completes. If it stays pending >1h, DM IT Support.

Noah Chen: i'm trying to register my YubiKey for 2FA but the portal errors out with "unsupported key".

IT Support: which key model? older YubiKey U2F-only models sometimes fail on WebAuthn flows. If you have a YubiKey 5 or newer, it should work. Send the model and OS via DM and we'll troubleshoot or issue a new key. Meanwhile you can use an authenticator app to finish setup.

Liam - InfoSec: FYI we prefer hardware keys for privileged accounts but allow authenticator apps for most roles during onboarding. Request a hardware key via People Ops if you want one on day 1.

Noah Chen: thanks — using 1Password TOTP for now. Enrollment link 404ed earlier but i retried and it's fine.

Marta (People Ops): Great. One more note: phishing simulation will run next Friday morning for recent joiners. If you click the test link you'll get immediate coaching and a short follow-up module. No disciplinary action.

Noah Chen: understood. If i need a company laptop later, what's the process?

Marta (People Ops): Reply here or DM me — we coordinate procurement and shipping. Typical lead time 3-5 business days.

IT Support: If anyone has enrollment or encryption issues, join #help-it or email it@redwood.com and include your OS, serial, and SSO email.

Liam - InfoSec: policy link for reference: https://security.redwood.com/byod-and-device-policy. Thanks and welcome aboard!"
